skills: Up to 3 Blood Axe slashes for Electric DMG. The 2nd leaps back and throws the axe; the 3rd is a flurry (mash or hold to extend; 40% DMG reduction) ending in a leaping smash. Both retreats can Perfect Dodge, after which she can resume the 3rd hit. Crimson Inscription doesn't end during it.

Outside Crimson Inscription: hammer strike for Electric DMG.

core.name: Banquet of Pale Blood
core.text:
All her DMG is Sharp DMG, scaling with DEF. Some of it builds Gash (max 3 stacks); her Cleaving Gold and Iron and Blood Burial Assault spend a stack to trigger Maim for area DMG.
Her CRITs use the Laceration DMG Bonus instead of CRIT DMG; CRIT Rate over 100% gives another roll to apply Laceration again. Each 1% of initial CRIT DMG gives 0.35% initial CRIT Rate.
Enters battle with 60 Sharpness (once per 180s in Investigation Zones). Crimson Inscription raises Anti-Interrupt, and Chain Attacks extend it by 2s.
In Crimson Inscription, or during Chain, Ultimate, Counter Assist or Assist Follow-Up: CRIT Rate +{0}% and Gash Buildup Rate +{1}%. A Perfect Dodge during Starforging or Subduing Axe gives +15% DMG for the rest of that skill.

ability.name: Bloodline Legacy
ability.text: Any squad Contamination gives her 300 Decibels (once per 18s). Any squad Maim puts all Armorer Agents in Remnant Edge: +25% Laceration DMG for 40s.

mindscapes: Laceration hits give +20% Gash Buildup Rate. Her Maims deal 130% of normal.
Crimson Inscription lasts 2s longer. In it, or during Chain, Ultimate, Counter Assist or Assist Follow-Up, she ignores 18% Electric RES.
The Starforging 3rd-hit flurry can be held longer. That hit, her Chain and her Ultimate deal +20% DMG.
Chain and Ultimate heavy hits trigger a single-target Maim without using Gash.
